parameters.query: SELECT o.id AS outreach_id, o.subject, o.body, o.recruiter_id, o.application_id, r.email AS recruiter_email, (SELECT count(*) FROM app.outreach s WHERE s.status = 'sent' AND s.sent_at > now() - interval '24 hours') AS sent_today FROM app.outreach o JOIN app.recruiters r ON r.id = o.recruiter_id WHERE o.status = 'approved' AND r.email IS NOT NULL ORDER BY o.approved_at ASC LIMIT 1;
